title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: How long a drill runs
hook: How long do you let one drill run?
intro: Then kids start drifting at minute twelve.
statement: A drill has a shelf life, and kids show you when it ends.
q1: Do you keep drills short and switch often —
q2: or let a good drill run long for more reps?
q3: What does your team look like at minute ten?
t1: Every team is different. But focus stays
t2: when drills end before attention does.
cta: Coaches — how long do your drills run?
ctaLines: Eight minutes. Ten. Until it stops working.
Short and many or long and deep?
ctaPrompt: Share your drill habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How long do you let one drill run?
The drill is working. Then kids start drifting at minute twelve.
A drill has a shelf life, and kids show you when it ends.
Short drills or long drills. There is no single right way.
How long do your drills run? Share your habit in the comments.
